title: USA Today and 13 Affiliates Sue OpenAI for Over $250 Million
summary:
A coalition of news outlets has filed a copyright infringement lawsuit against OpenAI over the unauthorized use of journalistic content to train its chatbot. USA Today and 13 affiliate organizations are seeking more than $250 million in damages, alleging the company improperly used news archives to develop ChatGPT and its associated outputs.

The legal action may establish a precedent for how machine learning companies utilize large-scale news archives, according to Reuters. The plaintiffs claim the usage of their intellectual property without permission violates current copyright law.
